at-0001.content: Always round monetary results with ledgerly.money.round_money (half-up to the cent); never use Python's round() or a bare Decimal.quantize(), which use banker's rounding and produce wrong invoice totals.

at-0005.title: Money-moving functions take keyword-only idempotency_key
at-0005.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. refund in ledgerly/adjustments.py) must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None`. Check it first via ledgerly.audit.events() for an existing entry with that key and return the original result without reapplying; include idempotency_key in the audit.record() call.
